## Agentic Commerce

- [Agentic commerce services](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/overview.md): PayPal's agentic commerce services help create AI-powered shopping experiences, so customers can shop using everyday language.
- [Advanced use cases](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/store-sync/your-api/advanced-use-cases.md): To extend your API beyond basic product sales, you can enable specialized shopping experiences. This guide shows you how to:
- [Integration use cases](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/store-sync/your-api/integration-use-cases.md): To handle real-world shopping scenarios that AI agents encounter, implement robust error handling patterns that provide clear context and actionable resolution options.
- [Set up your API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/store-sync/your-api/set-up-your-api/braintree-integration.md): To enable AI agents to create and manage shopping carts through your store, integrate with PayPal's Cart API.
- [Set up your API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/store-sync/your-api/set-up-your-api/orders-v2-integration.md): To enable AI agents to create and manage shopping carts through your store, integrate with PayPal's Cart API.
- [Response handling](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/agentic-commerce/store-sync/your-api/set-up-your-api/response-handling.md): To handle Cart API responses effectively and provide AI agents with the context they need for intelligent decision-making, understand the status fields and error patterns…
